This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their mottled [[Color|orange]] skin, large foreheads, low, wideset eyes, and lack of visible noses.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Narkina 5 Date">{{AndorDate|108}}</ref> a member of this species attended a party held at the [[Chandrilan Embassy]] hosted by [[Perrin]] and [[Mon Mothma]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Narkina 5">{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}}</ref> In [[3 BBY]], a member of this species attended a [[Senate Investiture]] [[Davo Sculdun's party|gathering]] hosted by [[Davo Sculdun]].<ref name="What a Festive Evening">{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}}</ref> Later, in [[34 ABY]],<ref name="TLJ Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] in [[34 ABY]]. ''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'' takes place immediately after the end of ''The Force Awakens''.</ref> yet another member of this species was seen with [[Centada Ressad]] at the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] in [[Canto Bight]] on [[Cantonica]] when the [[Resistance]] agents [[Finn]] and [[Rose Tico]] arrived searching for the [[Master Codebreaker]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Forehead-Species-Concept-Art.png|thumb|left|200px|Concept art for this species by Ivan Manzella]]
This species first appeared in the [[2017]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi]]'', directed by [[Rian Johnson]].<ref name="TLJ" /> This species was designed by concept artist [[Ivan Manzella]],<ref name="Ivan Manzella">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]''</ref> and was one of two species created for ''The Last Jedi'' that were referred to by the production code "King 21."<ref name="Ivan Manzella" /> One of the silicon bust masks used for this species was modeled by [[Sophie Rechtberger]].<ref name="Rechtberger">{{WebCite|url=http://sophierechtberger.com/silicone-busts-masks|text=SOPHIE RECHTBERGER|work=[http://sophierechtberger.com SOPHIE RECHTBERGER]|archivedate=20250518022123}}</ref>

[[File:Unidentified-Forehead-Species-Silicone-Bust-Mask.png|thumb|right|200px|One of the silicone bust masks created by Sophie Rechtberger]]
Keeper of the Holocron, [[Leland Chee]], expressed that he did not know why this happened, initially clearing up any confusion by referring to the [[Unidentified slimy species|other species]] as "King 21" in the official [[Holocron continuity database]], while this one was identified as "K021 species" behind-the-scenes,<ref name="Unnamed Aliens">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-04-01|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1356720840036847656|archivefile=File:Holocron-Keeper-Unnamed-Species-TLJ.png}}</ref> though he later realized the other species was also listed in the database under "King 36."<ref name="Production Codes">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-04-03|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1357405484679958799|archivefile=File:Holocron-Keeper-Masseur-Species.png}}</ref> As of [[April 1]], [[2025]], this species still did not have a name within Chee's Holocron.<ref name="Unnamed Aliens" />
